final_verdict: CORE SETTLED — DB-wide, both standalone AND book-marginal-core-integration. The 373-factor pipeline was searched to its limit under the previously-untested core-integration frame. (1) No factor is both orthogonal-to-core AND recent-positive (structural, §6). (2) Full-period core-integration APPEARS to yield +0.13-0.16 book ΔIR for ~18 factors, but this is a SWEEP ARTIFACT: incoherent category spread, within multiple-testing null, and — decisively — IS->OOS book_dIR correlation is ZERO (rho=-0.04) with IS-top decaying to OOS -0.088. The full-period 'survivors' (D09/M05/M17) are OOS-contaminated cherry-picks. (3) No new raw factor is justified — the recent-regime graveyard is universal across all 16 families. This is the definitive both-sides (standalone + book-marginal) DB-limit confirmation the prior 7f battery could not provide. Consistent with book ceiling ~1.1 (25-name KR) + cohort-wide 2015/2021+ decay + §6 '직교 ≠ 수익'.
